description: This file contains Pydantic models for a tic-tac-toe backend, defining user and game-related structures including user creation, game state, and history.

classes.name: UserBase
classes.description: Base model that contains common user-related fields including username and email.

classes.name: UserCreate
classes.description: Model for creating a new user, extending UserBase to include a password.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Model that represents a user with an ID and creation timestamp, extending UserBase.

classes.name: GameState
classes.description: Model representing the state of the game including the game board, current player, and winner.

classes.name: Game
classes.description: Model that represents a game instance including player IDs, game state, and timestamps.

classes.name: GameMove
classes.description: Model representing a move in the game with row and column indices.

classes.name: GameHistory
classes.description: Model to record history of games including winner information and timestamps.
